notes: 'in the open valley' renders 'upon the face of the valley': the preposition takes 'in', the construct 'face' takes the whole of 'open', and the rectum's article takes the single written 'the' by rule 29.

The doubled sābiyb sābiyb is split 'round' / 'about' under rule 2, each piece remaining meaningful; the competing reading fuses the pair as one English adverbial rendering under rule 30. The split is preferred because rule 2 asks for the smallest defensible unit.
